title: Staten Island Becomes the Place to Challenge Mamdani’s Policies in Court
summary: The ruling is a win for Mayor Zohran Mamdani, who argued that the case be heard in Manhattan. The lawsuit challenging the rent freeze had been filed in Staten Island.
